message.content: Based on the timeline provided in the messages, it appears that the process did not take more than three weeks. Initially, AdamSmith suggested recommending a split-type air-conditioner that would be suitable for the basement, and LiHua provided feedback on their preferences regarding energy efficiency and quiet operation. This discussion occurred on July 23rd at 14:00 (Message 5). On August 10th, AdamSmith reached out to check on the status of the warranty and maintenance plans for the air conditioner (Message 0), indicating that the initial recommendation and subsequent discussions took place within three weeks. Finally, on August 12th at 11:00 (Message 1), AdamSmith informed LiHua that the contractor team was scheduled to install the air-conditioner in the basement at 6 PM that day, suggesting that the actual installation was completed within a week after the recommendation was made. Therefore, the process from LiHua planning on acquiring the air-conditioner to its installation did not exceed three weeks.
